description: Single-panel pseudobinary phase diagram of the Fe–28Mn–10Al–0.8C–N system (calculated with Thermo-Calc, TCFE8 database per the citing text), plotting Temperature in K on the y-axis (labelled ticks 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1600, 1800, with the axis extending down to roughly 700 K) against Mass fraction of nitrogen wt/% on the x-axis (0.0 to 2.0, ticks every 0.5). Sixteen phase-field labels are printed directly on the diagram. The top region (above ~1600 K) is L+AlN, with a narrow L+γ+AlN field at the highest nitrogen on the right and a thin L+δ+AlN band near 1600 K that abuts a sliver labelled L+δ+γ+AlN near 1520 K at the low-nitrogen side. A large δ+γ+AlN field occupies the left half from about 1000 to 1500 K, bordered on the right by a γ+AlN field whose curved boundary sweeps toward lower nitrogen as temperature falls. Around 1000–1050 K on the right lies γ+AlN+M₅C₂; below it a δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂ band (~900–1000 K) narrows rightwards. The 700–900 K fields are δ+AlN+M₅C₂ (left), δ+AlN+M₂₃C₆ (right), a δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂+M₂₃C₆ sliver near 840 K, δ+γ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ (bottom right) and δ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ (bottom band). No numeric data points are printed, only phase labels and boundaries.

observations.observation: The figure is a single pseudobinary phase diagram with y-axis 'Temperature, K' (labelled 800–1800, axis extending to about 700 K) and x-axis 'Mass fraction of nitrogen wt/%' from 0.0 to 2.0 in 0.5 steps.

Phase-field labels printed on the diagram are: L+AlN, L+δ+AlN, L+δ+γ+AlN, L+γ+AlN, δ+γ+AlN, γ+AlN, γ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂+M₂₃C₆, δ+AlN+M₂₃C₆, δ+γ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ and δ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆.
The top of the diagram above roughly 1600 K is the L+AlN field, with a narrow L+γ+AlN wedge at the highest nitrogen (right edge) and a thin L+δ+AlN / L+δ+γ+AlN band around 1500–1600 K.

A large δ+γ+AlN field occupies the left half of the diagram between about 1000 K and 1500 K, while the neighbouring γ+AlN field lies to its right and its boundary curves toward lower nitrogen at lower temperature.
At about 1000–1050 K on the right side the field is labelled γ+AlN+M₅C₂, and beneath it a δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂ band (~900–1000 K) tapers as nitrogen increases.

The lowest region of the diagram contains δ+AlN+M₅C₂ (left, ~800–850 K), δ+AlN+M₂₃C₆ (right, ~850 K), a δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂+M₂₃C₆ sliver (~840 K), δ+γ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ (bottom right) and a δ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ band at the base.
No numeric composition/temperature data points, values or legend entries are printed on the diagram; all information is carried by phase labels and boundary curves.
The caption identifies the figure as the pseudobinary diagram of the Fe–28Mn–10Al–0.8C–N system.
The citing text states the diagram was calculated with Thermo-Calc software based on the TCFE8 database.
The citing text states that with increasing nitrogen content the maximum formation temperature and temperature range of the austenite phase increased significantly and ferrite gradually disappeared.
The citing text states nitrogen acts as an austenite-stabilizing element, expanding the austenite phase area and promoting austenite nucleus growth while preventing ferrite growth.

AlN appears in every high-temperature field label of the diagram, from L+AlN down to the low-temperature multi-phase fields, indicating AlN is stable over essentially the whole plotted nitrogen range.
Carbide phases M₅C₂ and M₂₃C₆ appear only below about 1050 K and 900 K respectively in the printed field labels, with M₂₃C₆ appearing already at ~900 K on the high-nitrogen right side per the labels.

subfigures.description: Pseudobinary phase diagram, Temperature (K, 700–1800) vs mass fraction of nitrogen (wt%, 0.0–2.0) for Fe–28Mn–10Al–0.8C–N, with 16 labelled phase fields including L+AlN, L+δ+AlN, L+δ+γ+AlN, L+γ+AlN, δ+γ+AlN, γ+AlN, γ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+AlN+M₅C₂, δ+AlN+M₂₃C₆, δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂+M₂₃C₆, δ+γ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆ and δ+α+AlN+M₂₃C₆.

unreadable_items: The lowest y-axis tick is unlabelled; the temperature at the bottom axis limit can only be judged as near 700 K from the tick spacing.

Some phase-boundary labels sit on closely spaced curves at the bottom of the diagram (near 800–850 K), making the exact curve assignment of the δ+AlN+M₅C₂ / δ+AlN+M₂₃C₆ / δ+γ+AlN+M₅C₂+M₂₃C₆ labels only partially readable.
